in_arabic.name: أجلان
in_arabic.long_meaning: أجلان هو اسم عربي يعني العز والشرف والسمو، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي أ ج ل، الذي يرمز إلى الفخر والسمو، ويستخدم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف الشخص العزيز والشريف، ولا يوجد له ذكر مباشر في القرآن الكريم ولكن يُستمد من التراث اللغوي العربي

in_urdu.name: اجلان
in_urdu.meaning: نام کا مطلب عزت اور شرف
in_urdu.long_meaning: اجلان ایک عرب نام ہے جو عزت اور شرف اور بلندی کی علامت ہے، یہ عرب جڑ ا ج ل سے ماخوذ ہے، جو فخر اور بلندی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اسلامی روایت میں اس شخص کی وضاحت کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو عزت والا اور شریف ہے

in_hindi.name: अजलान
in_hindi.meaning: नाम का अर्थ सम्मान और गर्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: अजलान एक अरबी नाम है जो सम्मान और गर्व और ऊंचाई का प्रतीक है, यह अरबी जड़ أ ج ل से लिया गया है, जो गर्व और ऊंचाई के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, और इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका उपयोग उस व्यक्ति के वर्णन के लिए किया जाता है जो सम्मानित और गर्वित है

in_pashto.name: اجلان

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Ajlan" carries a significant cultural impact within the Arabic speaking communities. While it is a name that is rooted in the natural world, it is also a name that holds deep symbolic meaning. Mountains and hills have long been considered sacred places within Islamic tradition. Al-Quran contains several references to mountains, such as Mount Sinai where Moses received the holy revelations, and Mount Tur in Hajj. Thus, the name Ajlan is not only a reference to the natural world but is also a symbol of strength, stability, and the ability to rise above challenges just as a mountain stands firm despite the elements.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name "Ajlan" is deeply rooted in the Islamic tradition's emphasis on perseverance, strength, and the power of the natural world. Mountains are considered sacred places in Islamic belief, representing a connection between the physical world and the divine. Ajlan is a name that carries these meanings with it. It signifies a person who, like a mountain, stands strong and unyielding in the face of challenges, a reminder that with steadfastness and a strong spirit, one can overcome any obstacle. It is also a reminder of the beauty and power of the natural world and the divine presence that resides within it.
